```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
```

```{r load}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(knitr); library(dplyr) })
source("config.R")
R    <- normalizePath(cfg$out_dir)
tab  <- function(f) read.delim(file.path(R, "tables", f), check.names = FALSE)
fig  <- function(f) knitr::include_graphics(file.path(R, "figures", f), rel_path = FALSE)
S     <- readRDS(file.path(R, "summary.rds"))
track <- tab("read_tracking.tsv")
taxa  <- tab("asv_taxonomy.tsv")
mock  <- if (file.exists(file.path(R, "tables", "mock_validation.tsv"))) tab("mock_validation.tsv") else NULL
eco   <- track[!track$sample %in% cfg$mock_samples, ]
fp    <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p))
perm  <- S$beta_tests[1, ]; disp <- S$beta_tests[2, ]
sig   <- S$da[S$da$q < 0.05, ]
```

## Summary

This report covers `r nrow(eco)` samples (`r paste(table(read.delim(cfg$metadata)$Group[read.delim(cfg$metadata)$Group != "Mock"]), names(table(read.delim(cfg$metadata)$Group[read.delim(cfg$metadata)$Group != "Mock"])), collapse = ", ")`) sequenced on the 16S rRNA V4 region (Illumina MiSeq, 2×250 bp), plus one mock community used as an accuracy control.

- **`r format(sum(track$input), big.mark = ",")` raw read pairs** were processed into **`r nrow(taxa)` amplicon sequence variants (ASVs)**; a median of **`r median(track$pct_retained)`%** of reads per sample passed every quality step.
`r if (!is.null(mock)) sprintf("- **Accuracy check:** in the mock community, %d of %d ASVs matched a known reference strain exactly, accounting for %.1f%% of mock reads.", mock$asvs_exact_match, mock$asvs_detected, mock$pct_reads_exact)`
- **Community composition differs between groups** (PERMANOVA R² = `r perm$R2`, `r fp(perm$p)`), explaining about `r round(100 * perm$R2)`% of between-sample variation.
- **Within-sample diversity** `r if (all(S$alpha_tests$p >= 0.05)) "does not differ significantly between groups" else "differs between groups"` (observed richness `r fp(S$alpha_tests$p[S$alpha_tests$metric == "Observed ASVs"])`; Shannon index `r fp(S$alpha_tests$p[S$alpha_tests$metric == "Shannon index"])`), so the groups differ in community makeup rather than in richness.
- **`r nrow(sig)` of `r nrow(S$da)` genera** differ significantly in abundance after correcting for multiple testing.

## 1. Read quality and processing

Quality profiles were used to set truncation lengths of `r cfg$trunc_len[1]` bp (forward) and `r cfg$trunc_len[2]` bp (reverse), where median quality stays well above Q30.

```{r, out.width="49%", fig.show="hold"}
fig("qc_quality_forward.png"); fig("qc_quality_reverse.png")
```

Reads were filtered (max `r cfg$max_ee[1]` expected errors, no ambiguous bases), denoised with DADA2, merged, length-filtered to `r cfg$expected_len[1]` to `r cfg$expected_len[2]` bp, and screened for chimeras. Before ecological analysis, `r S$offtarget$asvs_removed` off-target ASVs (mitochondrial, chloroplast, or unassigned at kingdom level; `r S$offtarget$pct_reads_removed`% of reads) were removed.

```{r, out.width="75%"}
fig("read_tracking.png")
```

<details><summary>Per-sample read counts</summary>
```{r}
kable(track[, c("sample", "input", "filtered", "merged", "nonchim", "pct_retained")],
      col.names = c("Sample", "Raw", "Filtered", "Merged", "Final", "% retained"), format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```
</details>

```{r, results="asis"}
if (!is.null(mock)) {
  cat("## 2. Accuracy check: mock community\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("The mock community is a defined mix of known bacterial strains, represented by %d reference 16S sequences. The pipeline recovered %d ASVs from it, %d of which match a reference sequence exactly (%.1f%% of mock reads). %s\n\n",
      mock$reference_sequences, mock$asvs_detected, mock$asvs_exact_match, mock$pct_reads_exact,
      if (mock$asvs_unexpected == 0) "No spurious ASVs were produced, so the error-correction step is not inflating diversity." else
        sprintf("The %d non-matching ASV(s) are low-abundance and consistent with minor contamination or residual errors.", mock$asvs_unexpected)))
}
```

## 3. Within-sample (alpha) diversity

```{r, out.width="85%"}
fig("alpha_diversity.png")
```

```{r}
kable(S$alpha_tests %>% mutate(p = fp(p)), col.names = c("Metric", "p-value", "Test"))
```

## 4. Between-sample (beta) diversity

```{r, out.width="70%"}
fig("beta_pcoa_bray.png")
```

PERMANOVA on Bray-Curtis distances shows group explains **`r round(100 * perm$R2)`%** of community variation (`r fp(perm$p)`, 9,999 permutations). `r if (disp$p >= 0.05) "Group dispersions do not differ significantly, so this result reflects a real shift in community centroid rather than a difference in spread." else "Group dispersions also differ, so part of the PERMANOVA signal may reflect differences in within-group spread; interpret with that in mind."`

## 5. Taxonomic composition

```{r, out.width="100%"}
fig("taxa_barplot_genus.png")
```

## 6. Differentially abundant genera

Genera present in at least 20% of samples were CLR-transformed and compared between groups with a Wilcoxon rank-sum test, with Benjamini-Hochberg correction.

```{r, out.width="85%"}
if (file.exists(file.path(R, "figures", "differential_abundance.png"))) fig("differential_abundance.png")
```

```{r}
kable(head(sig, 15) %>% mutate(p = signif(p, 2), q = signif(q, 2)),
      col.names = c("Genus", "Prevalence", "Median CLR diff.", "p", "q (BH)"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Methods

Paired-end reads were processed in R with DADA2 (v`r packageVersion("dada2")`). Reads were truncated at `r cfg$trunc_len[1]`/`r cfg$trunc_len[2]` bp and filtered at maxEE = `r cfg$max_ee[1]`; error rates were learned per run and used for sample inference. Pairs were merged with a minimum `r cfg$min_overlap` bp overlap, sequences outside `r cfg$expected_len[1]` to `r cfg$expected_len[2]` bp were removed, and chimeras were removed with the consensus method. Mitochondrial, chloroplast, and kingdom-unassigned ASVs were removed before community analysis. Taxonomy was assigned with the naive Bayesian classifier against SILVA v138.2 (minimum bootstrap 50) with exact-match species assignment. Community analyses used phyloseq (v`r packageVersion("phyloseq")`) and vegan (v`r packageVersion("vegan")`). Alpha diversity was computed on data rarefied to `r format(S$depth, big.mark = ",")` reads per sample. Beta diversity used Bray-Curtis distances on relative abundances, tested with PERMANOVA (adonis2) and homogeneity of dispersions (betadisper), each with 9,999 permutations.
